title: Match-server assignment
description: The one line of JSON a match server reads on its standard input when it starts (ADR-007 §5; version 2, ADR-010 §7, §9; version 5, ADR-021 §3). The backend writes it (Backend/internal/match/assignment.go) and VeyraServices binds it to FVeyraAssignmentDocument. It uses the tuning dialect (Game/Tuning/README.md) but is not tuning, and is not part of the tuning hash.

matchId.description: The match's ID, a lowercase UUID. The server reports under it.

backendUrl.description: The backend's base URL as the match server reaches it: http or https, a host, an optional port, no path.

serverCredential.description: The match-server credential (ADR-007 §2): vms_ and the base64url form of 32 bytes. Kept in memory only and never logged.

mode.description: The mode the match records (Modes & Access Bible §1), such as casual_select, custom_practice for solo Custom practice, or custom_game for a custom lobby's match.

rules.description: Standard for matchmade and developer matches; Practice for solo Custom practice, which its host ends (ADR-010 §7); Custom for a custom lobby's match, with its host, its bots and its settings (ADR-021 §3).

hostAccountId.description: The host of a Practice or Custom match, who must be on the roster; empty for standard rules.

participants.description: The roster: who may join, on which side, and as which Vanguard. Each side's size is checked against Match.json teams.maxTeamSize, and each Vanguard against Vanguards.json, when the server takes the assignment.

accountId.description: The participant's account ID, a lowercase UUID.

displayName.description: The name other players see. Any text without control characters.

side.description: Team A or Team B (Battleground Bible §15).

ticketHash.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the participant's join ticket (ADR-007 §3). The server never receives the ticket itself.

vanguardId.description: The Vanguard the participant locked in champion select, a content ID that Vanguards.json defines.

fluxSpells.description: The participant's starting Flux Spells, one per spell slot in slot order: a content ID on Abilities.json's roster, or an empty string for an empty slot (ADR-015 §5).

bots.description: The match's AI participants, which the server adds when the match starts (Custom Matches Bible §1; ADR-010 §7; ADR-021 §2). Only Practice and Custom matches have any, a Custom match's in each side's seat order. They count toward each side's Match.json teams.maxTeamSize, and are no account: no ticket, no result.

vanguardId.description: The Vanguard the bot plays, a content ID that Vanguards.json defines.

difficulty.description: How the bot plays (Custom Matches Bible §3; ADR-013 §6). It never changes the rules.

settings.description: A Custom match's session rules, set by its host for this one match (Custom Matches Bible §4; ADR-021 §3); empty for other rules.

victory.description: Whether a fallen Prime Well wins: Enabled only with a Vanguard on each side.

startingGold.description: Each Vanguard's starting Gold, or empty for Economy.json's gold.starting. The backend bounds it (customLobby.startingGold).
